g.text: Causal bandpass filtering helps, but a large precision gap remains
24 independent FID records; colored bands: 95% whole-record bootstrap intervals.
Threshold 0.002 A0; 10 kHz input noise; evaluation 0.2-1.5 s. All are stated assumptions.
Gray band: pixel-reading range, not a confidence interval. Original frontend settings unknown.
